title: Do Mixture-of-Experts Routers Benefit from Ensembling?
abstract: arXiv:2611.17472v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensembles of neural networks have repeatedly been shown to outperform single networks. Ensemble theory attributes this gain to the accuracy of the individual members and the diversity among them. Mixture-of-experts models already combine many experts, but a single router decides how the experts are weighted for each input. Motivated by ensemble theory, we apply ensembling to the routing step: an ensemble of routers, trained jointly with the experts, proposes the expert weights. We systematically evaluate this approach using underparameterized networks on two image-classification and two tabular-regression tasks. We analyse each experiment with a performance-diversity decomposition of the router ensemble, which, to our knowledge, has not previously been developed for routers. We report four findings. translated_title: 混合专家模型的路由器能从集成中受益吗？
translated_abstract: 神经网络的集成方法已被反复证明优于单一网络。集成理论将这种增益归因于各个成员的准确性以及它们之间的多样性。混合专家模型已经结合了许多专家，但由单个路由器决定每个输入下专家的权重分配。受集成理论的启发，我们将集成方法应用于路由步骤：由一组路由器集成（与专家联合训练）来提出专家权重。我们使用欠参数化网络在两个图像分类任务和两个表格回归任务上系统地评估了这种方法。我们通过路由器集成的性能-多样性分解来分析每个实验，据我们所知，这种分解方法此前尚未被开发应用于路由器。我们报告了四个发现。第一，更多的路由器降低了验证损失。第二，训练路由器显式地最大化专家多样性提高了平均性能。
tldr: 提出在混合专家模型的路由步骤中引入路由器集成方法，实验证明更多路由器可降低验证损失，且显式训练路由器最大化专家多样性能提升平均性能。
en_tdlr: Applying ensembling to the routing step of Mixture-of-Experts models, this work shows that more routers lower validation loss and explicitly training routers to maximize expert diversity improves mean performance.
